title: How AI Used Our Web Browser to Analyze Hundreds of LinkedIn Comments in Minutes
description: When Marketing AI Institute founder and CEO Paul Roetzer posted his take on New York City's decision to ban generative AI in public school classrooms, the response was immediate and voluminous.
